{{Quote|Are you a Padawan?''"<br />"''Not quite. AgriCorps. I'm here to assist the Ukians.''"<br />"''Oh, you're a washout.|Jedi Padawan [[Tyzen Xebec]] and [[Sanya]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref>}}
The '''Agricultural Corps''', or '''AgriCorps''', was one of the four branches of the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Service Corps]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The largest part of the Service Corps, this organization was formed so that those [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] who had failed to pass their [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Trials]] could use their connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] for the betterment of galactic society.

==Overview==
{{Quote|There's more ways for a Jedi to help people than by leading an army.|[[Sanya]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct" />}}
Made up largely of Jedi who had failed to complete their training at the [[Jedi academy]], as well as those [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had not been chosen as an apprentice by the age of thirteen,<ref name="TDR" /> membership in the AgriCorps was completely voluntary, though assignment to the Corps was handled by the [[Council of Reassignment/Legends|Council of Reassignment]]. Working in conjunction with the [[Republic Agricultural Administration]] to provide healthy crops to those under-privileged [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] suffering from natural disasters or blight, the AgriCorps also attracted ranking members of the Order who wished to take a more hands on approach to helping the common people of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. While working under the Reassignment Council, internal affairs were handled by the [[Council of AgriCorps Masters]].<ref name="TJP" />

While many within the lower ranks of the Order saw assignment to the Corps as a demotion, the Corps provided a great many necessities and was indeed just another facet of the Order. Maintaining research labs throughout the Republic, the [[Agricultural Circuit|Salliche Ag Circuit]] was one of the main hubs of activity within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Additionally the [[Jedi Agricultural Corps research laboratory/Legends|research labs]] within the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] provided great amounts of research to be filed into the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and served as a reservoir for information collected from all over the Republic. Facilities were also erected on [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]], [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], [[Marfa]], [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]], and [[Dilonexa XXIII]].<ref name="TJP" />

Members of the Corps focused on the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] and cultivating skills that aided in plant growth such as [[Plant Surge|''consitor sato'']]. While many Jedi served in the AgriCorps at some point in their service to the Order, the majority of this branch was made up of lifetime members. The AgriCorps had a branch of its own working within it consisting of [[Jedi geologist|geologists]] who would discover the secrets hidden in alien soil.<ref name="TJP" /> At any given point, up to 1,500 students were a part of the AgriCorps, with their ages ranging from 6 to 40 years old, although most were not older than 16. A small percentage of these students ended up not becoming [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] later in life due to not showing enough talent or focus, and an even smaller percentage of these ended up preferring agriculture over sword-fighting.<ref name="btr">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020411crise&c=rpg|text=Before the Rise}}</ref>

After the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] rounded up all of the AgriCorps members that weren't killed during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Transported to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] for indoctrination in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], those who fell to the Sith joined the ranks of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] active within the Empire. After the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] ended and the Dark Jedi along with the Sith were routed, the [[New Jedi Order|reformed]] Jedi Order did not rebuild the AgriCorps. While [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] knew of students that would have made great members of the Corps, such as [[Tahiri Veila]], he decided to join the AgriCorps philosophy with the main Order's doctrine.<ref name="TJP" />
